A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same AlphaPO work. All 26 pages of each version, including figures, tables, equations and appendices, support comparison; relocated and renumbered material can be matched.

before.justification: v2 reports original AlphaPO evaluations on AlpacaEval 2 and Arena-Hard, parameter ablations, training-dynamics analyses and SPPO continuation experiments.

after.justification: v4 retains those original experiments and additionally reports HellaSwag and TruthfulQA evaluations of AlphaPO and SimPO checkpoints.

M1.justification: The length-normalized alpha-parameterized reward, preference loss and training procedures are retained. SPPO continuation and the reference-policy variant also appear in both versions.

E1.justification: v4 adds HellaSwag commonsense reasoning and TruthfulQA truthfulness evaluation for Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Mistral-7B-Instruct (Section 4.2, Table 2). This substantially broadens task coverage beyond the retained preference and instruction-following evaluations; UltraFeedback training coverage is unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in matched experiments: DPO and SimPO remain in the main comparisons, and existing SFT and SPPO comparisons are retained. The added benchmarks compare against SimPO, introducing no new comparison method.

E3.justification: The added HellaSwag evaluation uses a 10-shot setting (v4 Table 2), and Appendix A.10 introduces a numerical sweep over alpha and common response length. Previously reported training budgets, response-generation procedures and alignment-evaluation settings are unchanged.

E4.justification: v4 Appendix A.10 and Figure 6 add a numerical sensitivity illustration of gradient magnitude across alpha and response length, extending the fixed-length toy examples. Existing model ablations, KL trajectories, reward distributions and likelihood-displacement analyses are retained.

E5.justification: The across-instruction standard deviations and Arena-Hard 95% confidence intervals in v2 Table 4 are retained in v4 Table 5. No new seed counts, repeated-run information, significance tests or uncertainty estimates are introduced; the added benchmark table reports point estimates.

E6.justification: v4 Table 2 adds eight benchmark scores, with AlphaPO above SimPO in all four model-task comparisons. For example, Llama-3 HellaSwag scores are 0.7694 for AlphaPO and 0.7576 for SimPO. These are newly reported evaluations; Table 1, the detailed alignment results and SPPO outcomes retain their values.

T1.justification: Theorems 3.1 and 3.2, Corollary 3.3, Lemma A.1 and their proofs and derivations are unchanged. The negative-margin example moves into Section 3.3; the new gradient surface illustrates existing mathematics without adding a formal result.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contribution: controlling reward shape through alpha to influence likelihood displacement and improve alignment. The stated 7–10% improvement over SimPO and 15–50% over DPO remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning regularization, likelihood displacement, length bias, early stopping and SPPO compatibility remain unchanged, as does the qualification that the theory analyzes individual examples. The new benchmark paragraph reports outcomes, while the generic Impact Statement adds no substantive limitation.

D1.justification: v4 documents the added HellaSwag 10-shot setting and the fixed parameters of its new gradient illustration, including beta=5 and gamma=0 (Appendix A.10). Existing training and decoding hyperparameters, hardware, runtimes and model identifiers are retained.

R1.justification: v4 adds the HellaSwag and TruthfulQA references and replaces the Llama 3 model-card citation with the already-cited Dubey et al. paper. Positioning relative to SimPO, DPO and f-DPO is retained; publication and bibliography updates are not new research coverage.

P1.justification: v4 lightly edits the title and abstract, corrects author text, adds conference information and an Impact Statement, and moves the negative-margin example from Appendix A.1 into Section 3.3. The overall narrative and section organization remain largely intact.

P2.justification: v4 adds the compact benchmark Table 2 and gradient-surface Figure 6. Figure 3 and several appendix plots relocate, with corresponding renumbering and page reflow; retained displays and the overall layout remain substantially unchanged.

improvement.justification: The HellaSwag and TruthfulQA comparisons add useful evidence beyond preference-evaluation benchmarks, while the gradient surface and relocated example improve explanation. The gain is limited: core results and theory are unchanged, and the new benchmark reporting omits exact metric definitions, detailed TruthfulQA settings and uncertainty estimates.
